label: late original-phase inputs of j/2/c/h/u/n/0
explanation: Diffuse unit that mainly fires during the original (input) phase. Its rate rises steeply with position, from 3% at orig_idx 1 to 29% at orig_idx 8, and it never fires at t=0. It prefers particular input tokens: j most strongly (28% rate, 5.7x lift, a quarter of the mass, and nearly all of the top activations are j at the last original position), then 2, c, h, u, n and 0. A smaller share (23% of mass) is in the copy phase, mostly at recall_idx 1-2 (the first outputs after <DEL>). It is nearly silent on the <DEL> step itself and late in the copy phase. Rate also rises with L and with the number of digits in the sequence. The predicate (original phase, t>=4, input in {j,2,c,h,u,n,0}) gets only dev F1 0.43 and mass recall 0.49; much of the activation is spread thinly over other tokens and positions and is not captured.
